movelist.name: Tailwind
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the encounter, all allied trainers and Pokémon gain +5 to their Initiative. Multiple instances of Tailwind cannot stack.

movelist.name: Defog
movelist.effect: The Weather becomes Clear, and all Blessings, Coats, and Hazards are destroyed. Clear Weather is the default weather, conferring no innate bonuses or penalties of any sort.

movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Hone Claws
movelist.effect: The user’s Accuracy is raised by +1, and the user gains +1 Attack Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).

abilities.name: Courage
abilities.effect: While at or under 1/3rd of its Max Hit Point value, the user gains a +5 Damage Bonus to all Damage Rolls, and 5 Damage Reduction. Defensive.

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.trigger: An adjacent Ally is hit by an attack
abilities.effect: The user and the triggering Ally switch places, and the user becomes the target of the triggering attack instead, taking damage from the attack as if resisted one step further. If switching places would not move the triggering Ally out of the area-of-effect of a Burst, Blast, Cone, or Line, this Ability does not prevent the ally from being hit. Defensive.
